name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd.
business_summary: One of India's largest mutual fund managers (ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund), also PMS, AIF and offshore advisory; very high operating margin (~73%). Recently listed (12m price data unavailable in pack), held ~51% by ICICI Bank and ~34.6% by Prudential plc (promoter group 85.60% after plc's 2026-08-26 block sale of up to 2%). Q2 FY27 PAT Rs889cr (+6.1% YoY) with higher yields on MF assets helping; Rs30 interim dividend. Mcap Rs1.46 lakh cr, P/E ~50, 52-week range Rs2,529-3,611; stock -10% in six months.

exposures.mechanism: AUM is ~70% equity-oriented (model estimate) so equity AUM/fees move with the market: +US$5bn FPI inflow/qtr ~ Nifty +2.5% -> equity AUM +2.5% (plus SIP effect) -> revenue +1.8% (equity ~75% of revenue) at 73% OPM => PAT +2.4%; stock's valuation multiple (50x P/E) amplifies sentiment ~2x => +4.5. Largely a market beta (~1.1); Director demeans cross-section.
